title: GitHub Product Ideas user configuration
description: User preferences for the GitHub Product Ideas skill. Stored at ~/.follow-builders/config.json

platform.description: Detected platform: openclaw or other (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)

timezone.description: IANA timezone string for scheduling (e.g. America/New_York, Asia/Shanghai)

frequency.description: How often to deliver the digest. The central feed currently refreshes weekly, so daily delivery may repeat the same edition

deliveryTime.description: Time of day to deliver digest in HH:MM format (24-hour)

weeklyDay.description: Day of week for weekly digests (only used when frequency is weekly)

delivery.description: How the digest is delivered to the user

method.description: Delivery method: stdout (terminal/agent), telegram (bot message), email (via Resend)

chatId.description: Telegram chat ID (only for telegram method)

email.description: Email address to send digest to (only for email method)

githubPreferences.description: User preferences for filtering and presenting projects from the published central GitHub feed

enabledGroups.description: GitHub project categories included in the digest

lookbackDays.description: Reserved lookback preference. The current client cannot expand or refetch the central feed based on this value

maxProjectsPerDigest.description: Maximum number of projects included in one digest

allowPreviouslyFeatured.description: Reserved repeat preference. Current deduplication is global in the central feed rather than independent for each user

onboardingComplete.description: Whether the user has completed initial setup
